description: This Java source file defines the ScriptEngine class, which is a part of the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements a generic script service engine that uses the javax.script API (JSR-223) to execute scripts or script functions within the context of OFBiz services. The class manages the setup of script execution environment, including injecting context objects into the script bindings, and handles invoking the script with proper error handling and result processing.

classes.name: ScriptEngine
classes.description: A final class implementing a generic scripting service engine using javax.script to execute scripts or script functions within OFBiz. It manages script context setup, invocation, and result/error handling.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a script service synchronously, preparing the script context with service parameters and context objects, invoking the script or function, and returning the outcome or error.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Performs the same as runSync but ignores returned result, mainly for fire-and-forget style script execution.
